newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan body to make BOJ recommendations by end-Jan.
newsitem.headline: Japan body to make BOJ recommendations by end-Jan.

text.p: A government committee discussing reforms to the Bank of Japan (BOJ) law will come up with a basic policy by the end of January, committee official Ryuichiro Tachi told reporters on Tuesday.
"We hope to come up with our basic policy by the end of January," he said.

The committee, under Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka's financial systems panel, met for a second time on Tuesday in an effort to finalise BOJ law reforms to increase the transparency and independence of the central bank.
The bills to carry out the reform will be submitted to the next regular session of the parliament starting in January.
Tachi said he did not know exactly when the bills would be submitted to parliament. A Finance Ministry official said government bills are usually submitted around mid-March.
